evaluation_order: Validate identity/session/account and required privileged assurance
Resolve explicit workspace and separate platform context
Find active role grants whose action AND scope AND field constraints match this request as one grant
Add matching individual allows within their exact scope
Apply any matching explicit individual deny; deny wins even over owner role allowance until authorised removal
Permit only requested fields and channel projection; otherwise deny
Recheck consequential command against current policy version and audit outcome
conflict_rule: Do not union scope from one grant with actions/fields from an unrelated grant; evaluate each matching grant atomically. A deny is restricted to its stated scope and never automatically global.
owner: Seeded own-workspace full authority including future company gyms; owner can edit company roles and individual grants, never platform admin. Last active owner remains recoverable.
platform: Separate platform-owned assignment; company roles cannot create it. Broad cross-platform inspection is supported with explicit audited workspace selection; no hidden impersonation or signature substitution.
mfa: Existing provider-supported privileged auth policy remains mandatory.
revocation: Reject new requests using obsolete grants; re-evaluate pending jobs and protected file deliveries. Previously downloaded bytes cannot be remotely erased by a role change.
policy_edit: Expected-version compare and diff preview; validate issuer delegation, scope and last-owner protection; atomically publish grants/version/audit and invalidate current permission projections. No production implementation claimed.

lifecycle_scope_contract.tenant_boundary: Every customer request has explicit owning workspace and applicable gym/record/field scope; this never disappears for archived records

action_classes.new_operation: Requires current operating service/readiness and permissions; closure/suspension cannot be bypassed
action_classes.retained_history_read: Allowed only within current explicit retained-history/audit/financial/document grants and retention; not blocked just because gym/workspace is archived
action_classes.resolution_or_recovery: Allowed only to current designated actors in exact source closure/recovery/reconciliation process; no reopening or new collection by implication
action_classes.trusted_source_evidence: Authenticated late payment/provider events and auditable corrections remain recordable by scoped service authority; does not reactivate customer services

lifecycle_scope_contract.forbidden_shortcut: Do not apply active_workspace == true to every read, callback or recovery command. Do not remove tenant/field restrictions to enable history.
